label: Compute share of cost of revenue, floor
why: The filing says 'substantially all' of cost of revenue is customer-serving compute; 90% is the floor used for the serving-compute range.

label: Serving utilization in H1 2026
why: The filing says the company has operated compute-constrained, demand exceeding supply. Revenue per serving-compute dollar observed in H1 2026 is scaled up by this to get revenue per fully used dollar.

label: Non-serving share of compute by the ramp year
why: H1 2026 non-serving share is derived from the filing (about 73%); where it settles as capacity scales is not disclosed.

label: Year the non-serving share reaches its end value
Annual change in revenue per used serving-compute dollar
why: Price cuts per release (Opus 5.5 −40% cost per task, Fable 5.1 −25%) are stated alongside 'preserving our margins'; 0% means efficiency offsets price.

label: Non-compute cash operating costs, % of revenue
why: H1 2026, natural classification: personnel less stock compensation, sales/marketing/partnerships (incl. channel fees), other opex less non-cash charitable charges, over revenue.

label: Cash tax rate on positive operating profit
why: US federal statutory rate; NOLs and credits ignored (conservative).

label: Count the undrawn revolver as liquidity
why: The $15B revolver is undrawn; off by default.

label: Payment ramp-in, years from each agreement's start
why: Capacity arrives in tranches; the filing says expenses are recognized as compute becomes available. Calibrated so the ledger's H2 2026 is closer to the observed Q2 2026 compute run-rate; 0 = straight-line.

label: Discount rate on revenue net of variable costs and tax
why: Unlevered cost of capital: 10-year Treasury 5.00% (2026-10-23) + median unlevered beta 1.33 of ten listed AI peers × US equity risk premium 4.46%. Unlevered because the fixed payments are valued separately at a debt rate.

label: Discount rate on fixed compute payments
why: Anthropic's own incremental borrowing rate as disclosed: lease-liability-weighted average of the operating (7.5%) and finance (7.1%) lease discount rates in Note 7.

label: Extra premium on the revenue-side rate
why: Zero in the base case; use it to stress pre-IPO, concentration or model-obsolescence risk beyond what listed peers' betas capture.

label: Revenue from usage-policy violators removed from the calibration
why: The filing estimates 5–7% of 9M 2026 revenue came from customers violating usage policy or commercial terms and expects it to decline; the midpoint is taken out of revenue per serving dollar.

label: Share of revenue lost to customer churn or in-sourcing
why: Zero in the base case. The stress presets use the top-five share the filing gives (Q3 2026) to model the largest customers moving to their own or a competitor's models.

label: Year the customer loss starts
why: Assumption; phased in over that year.
